serverInfo.name: sap.s4/CE_COSTCENTER_0001_MCP
serverInfo.title: Cost Center MCP Server
serverInfo.description: MCP server for the CE_COSTCENTER_0001 service. Provides read access to SAP S/4HANA Cost Center master data.

tools.name: listCostCenters
tools.title: List Cost Centers
tools.description: Get cost center entities from SAP S/4HANA Controlling. Supports filtering, sorting, pagination, field selection, and count. Returns CostCenter, CostCenterName, CostCenterDescription, ControllingArea, CompanyCode, ValidityStartDate, ValidityEndDate, CostCenterCategory, CostCtrResponsiblePersonName, Department, ProfitCenter.

top.description: Show only the first n items (max 100)

filter.description: Filter items by property values, e.g. ControllingArea eq '1000'

count.description: Include count of items in response (@odata.count)

orderby.description: Order items by property values, e.g. CostCenter asc

@odata.count.description: Total number of cost centers (when count=true)
